$comment: Per-agent model assignment, read by cli/src/model.ts and scripts/models. A consumer reads agents.<id>.tier, then profiles.<profile>.models.<tier>. Model specs are 'provider/model', where provider is an id from cli/src/providers/registry.ts ('mythos providers' lists them). The validator tier must differ from strong: a model approves its own errors 11.9 points more often when it wrote them, and that bias follows authorship, not the context window, so a fresh context on the same model is not an independent check. A profile that cannot provide a second model sets single_model_validation true, and the report must say the validator pass was not independent.

mythos.reason: the whole-run tier: it is what --model pins and what an unlisted agent falls back to

mythos-recon.reason: drives httpx, katana and ffuf and summarises the surface; later phases check what it finds

mythos-scanner.reason: runs nuclei, dalfox and sqlmap and records candidates, which are unproven by definition

mythos-exploiter.reason: decides candidate, tested or skipped per endpoint under the exploit skill and writes the evidence a validator will have to reproduce, so an error here is a wrong candidate rather than a slow phase

mythos-validator.reason: reproduces each candidate from the recorded bytes and may write confirmed or rejected; it has to be a different model from the exploiter, because a model approves its own errors 11.9 percentage points more often than another model's

mythos-reporter.reason: turns verdicts and findings into the deliverable, and computes nothing itself: a severity it cannot derive from a vector is caught by scripts/findings, not by the model

openrouter.label: One OpenRouter login, a cross-provider validator
openrouter.note: The default. One account reaches every model above, so the validator is a genuinely different model without a second subscription.

zai.label: Z.ai coding plan only
zai.validator_note: No second model fit to re-check a proof, so the validator pass runs on the hunting model and is not independent. Add a second provider, or accept that every finding carries the limitation.

anthropic.label: Anthropic API keys
anthropic.note: Validator is a different model in the same family, which is weaker evidence of independence than a different vendor but still not self-review.

local.label: Ollama, nothing leaves the machine
local.needs: ollama serve, and the models pulled
local.validator_note: One local model does every tier. Useful for a target whose traffic may not leave the network; not useful for independent validation.

validation.$comment: Which model re-checks a finding before the report is written.
validation.runs: cli/src/driver.ts, before the report phase; writes validation.md
validation.why: A fresh context does not remove self-preference: it is tied to authorship. Measured at 11.9 percentage points over 64,800 calls. Where validator equals strong the pass is a re-run, not an independent check, and the report has to say so.
validation.cross_provider_example: mythos -t <url> --profile openrouter  (validator is openai/gpt-5.2-mini while the hunt runs on z-ai/glm-5.3; `scripts/models <profile>` prints what a profile resolves to)
